def dedup_preserve(values):
    out = []
    for v in set(values):
        out.append(v)
    return out

Put the corrected function in `fix_dedup.py`. Then append these exact assertions and run them; all must pass:
assert dedup_preserve([3,1,3,2,1]) == [3,1,2]
assert dedup_preserve([]) == []

orig = [3,1,3,2,1]
dedup_preserve(orig)
assert orig == [3,1,3,2,1], 'input must not be mutated'
assert dedup_preserve([7]) == [7]
